prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the main composition reference to preserve subject placement, crop, prop scale, and text-panel layout.
Use the source image as a strict face and wardrobe reference for the model so gpt-image-2 stays close to the original portrait.
Preserve all visible text exactly: 'BADASS', 'SLOW FASHION', 'TẶNG 2 SỊP BADASS CAO CẤP', and 'TẶNG ÁO / QUẦN BADASS'.
Keep the image square and maintain the large empty yellow background with the cropped blue shape at the top right.
Do not replace the gift box with shopping bags or other props; the white ribboned box is essential to the promo concept.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a BADASS premium fashion gift giveaway promotion. Create a bright yellow background with a soft glowing gradient and a large cropped royal-blue angular graphic shape in the top-right corner. Place a photorealistic young Asian male model on the right half, upper-body to thigh crop, facing camera with a calm friendly expression, neat black hair, wearing a white short-sleeve textured knit polo with subtle vertical cable lines and a small dark crest logo on the chest, black trousers, and a brown-strap wristwatch. His left arm should rest casually on a large white gift box on the left side, tied with a dark green ribbon bow and diagonal ribbon bands. Print the bold black word 'BADASS' on the front of the box and small text 'SLOW FASHION' near the lower edge. At the bottom, add two glossy rounded royal-blue text panels with bold white uppercase Vietnamese text exactly reading 'TẶNG 2 SỊP BADASS CAO CẤP' on the left and 'TẶNG ÁO / QUẦN BADASS' on the right. Include a small cropped white chair seat at the lower right under the model. Style should feel like a polished celebrity fashion promo with clean ecommerce retouching, bright studio-commercial lighting, crisp cutout edges, cheerful high-key atmosphere, photorealistic fashion advertising poster with graphic promo overlays, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
